The matrix is square, with rows and columns labeled by these features. Each cell contains a numerical correlation value (e.g., 0.92, -0.15) and is colored according to its value, using a diverging 'coolwarm' colormap (red for negative correlation, blue for positive, white/light for near zero). The correlation coefficient values are annotated within each cell. The X-axis labels are rotated for readability. A color bar on the right is labeled "Correlation Coefficient'. The title is "Correlation Heatmap of Student Performance Metrics" in bold.
